= Centurion =
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Centurion
|Image  = Centurion.png
|HP     = 76-80
|AscHP  = 78-83
|Debut  = Act 2
|Type   = Normal
}}
'''Centurion''' is a normal [[Monsters|Enemy]] encountered exclusively in [[Act 2]].

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Centurion}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Slash
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (12;{{Asc|2|14}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Protect
|Intent = Defend
|Effect = {{M|Mystic}} gains (15;{{Asc|17|20}}) {{KW|Block}}. If alone, instead gains (15;{{Asc|17|20}}) {{KW|Block}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Block
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Fury
|Intent = Attack4
|Effect = Deals (6×3;{{Asc|2|7×3}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
'''Centurion''' will use one of the following actions each turn if the {{M|Mystic}} is alive:
* {{Int|Centurion|Slash}} (65% chance)
* {{Int|Centurion|Protect}} (35% chance)
If the {{M|Mystic}} is dead, '''Centurion''' will replace {{Int|Centurion|Protect}} with {{Int|Centurion|Fury}}. '''Centurion''' will never use any move three times in a row.

== In Party With ==
=== Act 2 ===
As a hard pool encounter alongside:
* 1 {{M|Mystic}}

= Mystic =
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Mystic
|Image  = Healer.png
|HP     = 48-56
|AscHP  = 50-58
|Debut  = Act 2
|Type   = Normal
}}
'''Mystic''' is a normal [[Monsters|Enemy]] encountered exclusively in [[Act 2]].

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Mystic}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Attack
|Intent = DebuffAttack2
|Effect = Deals (8;{{Asc|2|9}}) damage. Applies 2 {{BD|Frail}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Frail
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Buff
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = All enemies gain (2;{{Asc|2|3}} ; {{Asc|17|4}}) {{BD|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Heal
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = All enemies heal (16;{{Asc|17|20}}) HP.
|GivesToEnemy = Heal
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
If an enemy is missing 16 ({{Asc|19|21}}) or more HP, '''Mystic''' will use {{Int|Mystic|Heal}}, up to twice in a row. Otherwise, '''Mystic''' will use one of the following actions each turn:
* {{Int|Mystic|Attack}} (60% chance)
* {{Int|Mystic|Buff}} (40% chance)
Mystic will never use {{Int|Mystic|Attack}} or {{Int|Mystic|Buff}} three times in a row.

On {{Asc|17|Ascension}}, '''Mystic''' will never use {{Int|Mystic|Attack}} twice in a row.

== In Party With ==
=== Act 2 ===
As a hard pool encounter alongside:
* 1 {{M|Centurion}}
